ai.title: Free tier credit limit lowered to 500
ai.summary: The `FREE` plan credit limit in `common/src/constants.ts` was reduced from 1,000 to 500 in `PLAN_CONFIGS`. This change directly impacts the monthly usage cap for free users. No other plan tiers or configuration fields were modified.

eli5.text: Free users now get 500 credits per month instead of 1,000, that's the cap on how much you can use the service each month with the free plan. If you look at your usage dashboard, you will see the limit displayed as 500 instead of 1,000. This change only affects the free plan; paid plans keep their existing limits.
